questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: When a lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger, it signals the group to form a single-file line. This is a key hand signal for group riding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that an upcoming bridge is narrow. You may not have room to safely meet or pass a truck on this bridge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal tells other riders to follow you. It is a basic hand signal used when riding in groups.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a one-way sign. All traffic must travel in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead. Reduce your speed to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Only proceed after you have stopped and confirmed the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that there is low clearance ahead. Be prepared for an area with reduced overhead space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. You must stop completely, check for pedestrians and traffic, and wait for the intersection to clear before continuing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points it downward, this hand signal means they plan to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead where another road crosses.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in the direction you are heading.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for other traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, riders behind should reduce speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on or near the road ahead.
